name: Amaranth Damping-Off
description: A soil-borne disease affecting amaranth seedlings, causing pre- and post-emergence damping off. It is a major constraint in nursery and direct-seeded amaranth production.
symptoms: Seedlings collapsing at soil line with water-soaked stems
White or brown fungal growth on affected seedlings
causes: Pythium spp. and Rhizoctonia solani fungi
Overcrowded seedbeds with poor air circulation
treatments: Remove and destroy affected seedlings immediately
Drench soil with copper oxychloride or metalaxyl
prevention: Use well-drained nursery beds or seed trays
Avoid overwatering and ensure proper drainage
Space seeds adequately to reduce crowding
Treat seeds with fungicide before planting
